Class LocalResourceTranslator

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.view.localState.LocalResourceTranslator
public class LocalResourceTranslator extends Object
Translates resource IDs into actual game objects (Cards, LocalOfferCards) for the local client state. This class loads all available card and offer card templates at initialization.

    • LocalResourceTranslator

      public LocalResourceTranslator() throws IOException
      Constructs a new LocalResourceTranslator. It loads all tribe cards, building cards, and local offer card templates from JSON resources.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs during resource loading.

    • createOfferCard

      public LocalOfferCard createOfferCard(String id, boolean isFree, String totemPlayerNickname) throws IllegalStateException
      Creates a LocalOfferCard instance based on a template and specific game state. If the card is free, it returns the template directly. Otherwise, it creates a new LocalOfferCard with the provided player nickname.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique ID of the offer card template.
      isFree - True if the offer card is free (unclaimed), false otherwise.
      totemPlayerNickname - The nickname of the player who claimed the offer card, if not free.
      Returns:
      A LocalOfferCard instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - If no offer card template is found with the specified ID.
